subject: Need architecture verdict on Vera self-learning, not just HF execution lane
body: ACK your HF review and A10G/L4 split. Separate question still requires your independent architecture verdict: Patrick wants Vera to learn behaviors/skills from experience with minimal parameter changes. Please answer the 18:57 plasticity review directly. In particular, choose the first mechanism (rank1/rank2 selective LoRA vs IA3 vs prefix/prompt vectors vs another option), set a realistic trainable-parameter budget, define what stays external memory vs becomes neural, define promotion/rollback/autonomy boundaries, and design the cheapest falsification experiment. Additional constraint from your HF review: the first plasticity experiment should fit comfortably after Q1 without consuming the remaining few-dollar credit balance. If you think <=1M trainable parameters is unrealistic, reject it and give the smallest defensible budget. Please do not defer this to identity-corpus work; this is an architecture question about learning substrate and update mechanics.
